NEW GROK BOT!

THE ULTIMATE SHOPPING AGENT!

I just saved $50 on a 1TB USB-C storage drive, and I didn't dig through a single coupon site to do it! 

Grok Bot did!

I built what is the ultimate shopping agent on Grok Bot. 

Here's what it does:

🛍️ Finds the lowest real total. It ranks every option by item price plus shipping, tax, and fees. If it can't confirm a charge, it says the total is incomplete instead of guessing.

🎟️ Tests coupon codes before it shows them. It only reports codes it actually tried and saw accepted, with the source, the savings, and the new total. Fake "verified" codes get thrown out.

📊 Shows every discount and how it applies. That means sale prices against the regular price, store promos, member pricing, free-shipping thresholds, and bundles. Each one comes with its source and the exact price before and after.

🧮 Builds a feature comparison grid. Price, shipping, speed, ratings, durability, and warranty, all side by side across up to 10 options, with product cards and photos.

🚫 Filters out scams. It skips the "$19 2TB drive" listings and sketchy stores you've never heard of.

📞 LOCAL MERCHANT SUPPORT! Calls local shops for you. If you'd rather support a small local merchant, it can phone nearby stores to ask about price, stock, and deals, and then put their quotes in the same comparison.

🔔 Watches sales, prices, and stock. It sets up quiet watches for announced sales, price drops, and restocks, and only pings you when something real happens.

🔒 Never buys without your yes. You see the exact items, total, and terms before anything is checked out.

It's my own shopping department, running 24/7. 

And I made it a template, so you can get your own copy of it.

Don't go shopping wiothout it. 

GET IT HERE: https://x.ai/bot/eYPh2Q9TsdwAEeWDhRnot
